title: OSS survey: agent observability, guardrails & policy engines — reuse vs. missing
outcome: A reuse/build decision for Monitor and Containment based on what OSS tools actually do (read from code/READMEs)
acceptance: ≥6 tools surveyed with repo URLs, licence and activity (e.g. Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, OpenLLMetry, NeMo Guardrails, LlamaFirewall, OPA or Cedar)
Capability matrix: tool × per-agent attribution, OTel export, live alerting, block single call, quarantine whole agent, revoke credentials, offline/no-key use
Each capability marked 'verified in code/docs' vs 'claimed'
'Implications for our design' section with explicit reuse/build/avoid list
